metadata.label: scenario estimate, not validated
metadata.purpose: Input record for Ajit's real-farm go/no-go (plan step 3). Inputs only; the go/no-go itself is not run here.

origin_vocabulary.user_supplied: a value Ajit gave for his own farm
origin_vocabulary.repo_research_pack: data/sources/research_reports/markdown/First-slice basil wholesale economics input pack.md (non-canonical research benchmark)
origin_vocabulary.sourced_candidate: read from an external source in this pass; candidate until Ajit approves it
origin_vocabulary.derived_candidate: arithmetic on the cited values only; no new assumption added
origin_vocabulary.missing: no source yet; left null and reported as a gap

metadata.location_note: Ajit asked (2026-11-25) to compare India and the Netherlands side by side. Location-specific values live under locations.<name>; farm_inputs holds Ajit's own answers.
metadata.reliability_fields: source_tier (government_statistics / peer_reviewed / extension_case_study / grey_literature / research_pack_operator_assumption / derived), confidence (high/medium/low), confidence_reason

location.note: Region within India not given yet; India values below mix all-India wage orders and a Tamil Nadu tariff.

grow_area_m2.default_origin: sourced_candidate (UVI commercial system, Rakocy et al. 2002 and Heidemann and Bailey 2015)

building_type.note: greenhouse / indoor with lights / existing space / seasonal. Drives heating and electricity most.

electricity_eur_per_kwh.default_origin: repo_research_pack (CBS delivered non-household 500-2,000 MWh/yr, 2024 H1 to 2025 H2)

heating.note: Fuel type and annual heat demand are both unknown. Gas price reference below.

basil_sales_channel_and_price_eur_per_kg.default_origin: repo_research_pack (Dutch importing wholesaler examples, March 2020; refresh needed)

owner_hours_costed.note: Whether Ajit's own time is charged as a cost. Decisive for the result, see review doc.

hired_labour_eur_per_hour.default_origin: repo_research_pack (Dutch greenhouse CAO 1 July 2025 plus 2026 employer burden)

nl_non_household_gas_eur_per_m3.source: CBS StatLine 85666ENG, Prices of natural gas and electricity, band 28,433 to 284,333 m3/yr (1,000 to <10,000 GJ), incl. VAT and tax, read 2026-11-25
nl_non_household_gas_eur_per_m3.caveat: Smallest non-household band on the page; a small farm may use less gas and pay a different price.
nl_non_household_gas_eur_per_m3.confidence_reason: Official CBS table read directly; band may be larger than a small farm

uvi_system_physical_inputs.source: Heidemann and Bailey 2015, Commercial Aquaponics Case Study #3: Economic Analysis of the UVI Commercial Aquaponics System (draft, AEC 2015-18), Tables 7, 8 and 11
uvi_system_physical_inputs.labour_basis: 2 people x 30 h/week x 52 weeks, whole system (fish, lettuce, basil)
uvi_system_physical_inputs.electricity_basis: 14,235 kWh fish + 9,125 kWh plants; tropical site, no heating or grow lights
uvi_system_physical_inputs.currency_and_year: USD, prices as of 2014, St. Croix
uvi_system_physical_inputs.caveat: Whole-system figures. The source does not split labour or electricity between fish, lettuce and basil. Materials-only build cost, owner-built, $2,000 tropical greenhouse.
uvi_system_physical_inputs.confidence_reason: Itemised university case study, but a draft not departmentally reviewed; tank volumes in Fig. 2 and Table 1 disagree; basil and lettuce share the same raceways so crop shares are unknown

uvi_basil_trial_yield.source: Rakocy, Shultz, Bailey, Thoman, Aquaponic Production of Tilapia and Basil: Comparing a Batch and Staggered Cropping System (UVI, 2002 trials), Table 6
uvi_basil_trial_yield.caveat: Annual projection from trial data. Authors say batch is not sustainable with the fish output.
uvi_basil_trial_yield.confidence_reason: UVI research station trial report; annual figures are projections; the later economic study uses 3,000 kg/yr instead, so the two UVI sources differ by about 40%

cost_basis_candidates.note: Upper-bound charging: all UVI whole-system labour and electricity charged to basil kg. This overstates basil's share and leaves out heating, lights, feed, seed, fingerlings, chemicals and packaging, so it is neither a full cost nor an allocation.
cost_basis_candidates.fixed_cost_note: UVI depreciation and rent are USD 2014 for an owner-built tropical system. No EUR conversion or Dutch build cost is sourced yet, so the EUR 500 batch fixed cost has no sourced replacement.
cost_basis_candidates.netherlands_note: The EUR figures below are the Netherlands case.
cost_basis_candidates.confidence_reason: Whole-system UVI hours and kWh with no crop split, charged entirely to basil; tropical site with no heating

labour_inr_per_harvested_kg_andhra_basis.note: Andhra study's own 288 labour days and 238 kg, re-priced at burdened minimum wage
labour_inr_per_harvested_kg_andhra_basis.confidence_reason: Basil-specific, but one small study with an unusually low yield; low yield inflates per-kg labour

india.labour_uvi_basis_note: Needs hours per paid day to convert UVI's 3,120 h; not sourced, so left null.

electricity_inr_per_harvested_kg_uvi_bas.confidence_reason: UVI tropical kWh is a reasonable climate match for much of India, but excludes demand charges

saleable_harvest_mass_kg_note: Not inferred. Needs observed runtime output or a reviewed manual value approved by Ajit (AGENTS.md 1C).

basil_price_per_kg.confidence_reason: CBI 2024 report citing March 2020 Dutch importer/wholesaler examples; stage matches bulk wholesale but prices are old and tax treatment not normalized

hired_labour_per_hour.confidence_reason: CAO wage scales and Tax Administration 2026 contribution rates are official, but the burden loading on top is a research-pack allowance

electricity_per_kwh.confidence_reason: CBS delivered non-household price 500-2,000 MWh/yr band, 2024 H1 to 2025 H2; a small farm may sit in a smaller band

gas_per_m3.confidence_reason: CBS 85666ENG, read directly; caveat that the smallest band shown (28,433+ m3/yr) may be larger than a small farm

saleability_rate.confidence_reason: operator assumption informed by postharvest science, not a measured rate

india.eur_comparison_note: Research pack gives EUR equivalents at an ECB comparison rate for comparison only; not used in calculations here.

basil_price_per_kg.confidence_reason: Only anchor is a 2025 Andhra Pradesh hydroponic study's Rs 1,000/kg sale price, not a first-wholesale trade price; 600 and 800 are operator haircuts

hired_labour_per_day.confidence_reason: Chief Labour Commissioner April 2025 agriculture minimum wages (Rs 465-610/day) x 1.1525 statutory-burden proxy; the burden factor is a proxy and hours per day are not stated

observed_study_labour_per_day.confidence_reason: Direct cash labour as costed in the Andhra study; well below the legal minimum wage, so not a compliant commercial rate

electricity_per_kwh.confidence_reason: 7.5 is the Tamil Nadu HT Tariff I energy charge (2025); 8.5 and 9.5 are allowances for state/category spread; demand charge Rs 608/kVA/month excluded

heating.confidence_reason: Likely small in most Indian regions but cooling/shading may matter instead; no source yet

andhra_study_reference.confidence_reason: Single open-access 2025 study; values read via the research pack, not re-read from the paper in this pass
andhra_study_reference.system: naturally ventilated polyhouse NFT (hydroponic, not aquaponic)
andhra_study_reference.cross_check: About 25x below UVI's 23.4 kg/m2/yr. The period behind the 238 kg is not stated in the pack; re-read the paper before using this yield.
